test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option which has no spelling error.

The roll of the Union goverment is technical.

options.text: The role of the Union goverment is tecnical.
The rolle of the Union government is technnical.
The role of the Unioun goverment is technical.
The role of the Union government is technical.

solution:
The correct answer is- " **The __role__ of the Union government is technical**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option with no error is** *Option 4*.**
 
• Here, we should use the word- "**Role**" in place of "**Roll**".
 
• The word "**Role**" is used to refer to "**the function or** the position** of something **".
 
 
• **Example:** *The **role** of a Teacher in a student's life is very crucial.​*
 
 

**​​The correct sentence:*** *The role of the Union government is technical.

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

* *​Let us understand the meaning of other options as well.

 
• **Roll** - It means "**to move something in a tube-shaped**".

 
 
• **Example**:* I **rolled** up my chart paper after finishing the sketch.*
 
 
 
• ​**Technical: **It is** **used to describe the depth or level of knowledge a person has about a subject.
 
 
• **Example:** *He was denied promotion due to his lack of **technical** knowledge.*
